notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch (curl, desktop UA) for HTML/breadcrumb JSON-LD/title/meta-description; PLP totals read from the server-rendered 'plp-catalog-filter-information__total-count' element ('N Produkte'), the same reliable pattern on every genuine IKEA PLP - no Playwright needed except one page (VINTERFINT, see below) where that element never rendered server-side. robots.txt (global, ikea.com/robots.txt - de-DE has no separate file) checked, no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: homepage embedded nav links, DE category sitemap (sitemaps/cat-de-DE_1.xml, full-text keyword scan for weihnacht/ostern/halloween/herbst/sommer/fest/saison/valentin/diwali/eid/silvester/karneval/fasching/nikolaus/muttertag/vatertag/black-friday/adventskalender and more - see excluded/absent list below), the 'Weihnachten' (Christmas) hub wt001, the 'Trends' hub, the 'Kollektionen' (named collections) hub, and the 'Saisonale Feste in Schweden' (Swedish Seasonal Festivals) hub 700321 - the same shared cross-market node id as IKEA UK's 'Seasonal Celebrations' (se92), confirming DE and UK share underlying category ids even where DE frames/brands them differently. IKEA DE's seasonal taxonomy mirrors UK's structurally (same numeric ids: wt001, 49149-49160, 49227-49233, 53254-53256, 700321/326-329/552/570/606/668) but content and inclusion differs per DE's own titles/descriptions - evaluated independently, not copied from UK. Two grouping rows kept per rule 9 (parent total ~= union of children, not double-counted): 'Christmas' (wt001, pure hub, no own product grid) and 'Christmas Food' (Festessen 49227, own count 17 ~= its 3 children's 13+3+2=18, i.e. the parent IS the aggregate). 'Summer Food' (53254) also kept as a grouping label even though its own count (39) doesn't equal its 2 children's sum (27+30=57, meaning the two children overlap each other), to avoid triple-counting - all three rows still supplied since each has real evidence. 'Saisonale Feste in Schweden' (700321, 244 products) kept as its own flagged grouping row exactly as IKEA UK did for the same node - it mixes 5 occasions (Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Midsummer, Crayfish Party) under one PLP; its per-occasion children are the rows already listed under their own holiday categories above/below, not duplicated here. Overlap/duplicate dropped (rule 0.6 - identical product set under two URLs): 'Blumentöpfe & Vasen für Weihnachten' (49160, 2 products) is byte-for-byte the same 2-product listing as 'Pflanzen und Pflanzentöpfe für Weihnachten' (49151, kept) - confirmed by comparing product names on both pages. Dropped as 0-current-products (page loads, no product grid total, matches IKEA UK's identical finding for the same cross-market ids): Weihnachtskugeln & Weihnachtsbaumschmuck (49155, Christmas baubles/tree ornaments - UK's 49155 was also 0), Weihnachtsblumen & Weihnachtsbäume (49158, Christmas trees - UK's 49158 was also a 0-item duplicate), Weihnachtskränze & Weihnachtsgirlanden (49159, Christmas wreaths & garlands). Dropped, currently not live: VINTERFINT Christmas collection (id 47706) - page resolves and is Christmas-branded in its meta description, but has no server-rendered product-grid total and is absent from the live 'Kollektionen' hub listing as of this visit (unlike HÖSTAGILLE/TJÄRLEK/KUSTFYR, which are all live) - appears to be the not-yet-launched 2026 Christmas collection; not written as a row per the 0/no-evidence convention. Excluded as non-seasonal cross-links or generic categories reached from a seasonal hub but not themselves seasonal-specific (rule 5/6): 'Tischdeko für jeden Anlass' (49156, breadcrumb child of Christmas Decorations 49149 but titled 'table decor for every occasion' with an all-generic tablecloth/vase product sample, no Christmas naming) - excluded; LED-Lichterketten (700180, generic mood string lights) and Tischleuchten & Dekolampen (700179, generic table/decor lamps) - both linked from the Christmas hub but generic year-round lighting, matching IKEA UK's identical exclusion of String Lights/Decorative Lamps as non-Christmas-specific cross-links. Excluded as marketing/sale page: 'angebote-fuer-weihnachtsprodukte' under /offers/ (Christmas offers/sale, not a category PLP). Excluded as life-event (not calendar-seasonal) gift categories found on the Trends hub: Hochzeitsgeschenke (wedding gifts, 100 products - a life-event gift category, not tied to a recurring calendar date, unlike a true 'Wedding Season' occasion), Geschenke zum Schulabschluss/Abitur (graduation gifts), Geschenke zum Einzug (housewarming gifts). Excluded as non-holiday Trends-hub themes: cooling summer bedding (700857, functional/climate textile, not an occasion), football/outdoor-cinema decor (700833), teen-room furniture, tea, budget items, beach accessories, balcony/outdoor decor, reading corner - none tied to a specific holiday/festival. Included with MANUAL REVIEW flags rather than silently excluded, per the instruction that a generic seasonal-color/style category should be flagged not silently dropped when genuinely ambiguous: 'Herbstdeko für dein Zuhause' (Autumn Decor, 700796, 184 products - meta description frames it as 'warm colours for the season' rather than a named autumn event) and 'Sommerdeko für dein Zuhause' (Summer Decor, 700795, 166 products, same style-led framing); both sit under the site's own 'Trends' hub as standalone seasonal-decor categories (not linked from Christmas), separate from the genuinely named HÖSTAGILLE Autumn Collection. Also flagged: 'Festtagssüssigkeiten' (49232) - its own meta description explicitly frames it as multi-occasion ('immer passend zu Feiertagen & besonderen Anlässen im Jahr'), yet it is nested in the Festessen/Christmas-adjacent branch and its sampled products (KAFFEREP gingerbread, DELIFIKA mulled-wine roll) are classic German Christmas items - kept under Christmas with a flag rather than excluded, since the ambiguity is genuine. Checked and confirmed NOT present anywhere in the DE category sitemap, homepage nav, Trends hub, or Collections hub (all keyword variants checked: valentin/valentinstag, diwali, eid - the only 24 sitemap hits for 'eid' were false positives inside 'Kleid/kleider' words, verified individually, silvester, karneval/fasching, nikolaus/nikolausstiefel, erntedank, muttertag/muttertagsgeschenke, vatertag/vatertagsgeschenke, black-friday, cyber-monday, adventskalender, osterdeko/osterhase/osterei as standalone categories outside the Sweden-branded Easter page, jahreswechsel/neujahr): Diwali, Eid, Valentine's Day, Easter as a standalone German-market category (Easter only exists DE-side via the Swedish-branded 'Ostern in Schweden' page and the TJÄRLEK collection), Thanksgiving, New Year, Holi, Raksha Bandhan and other Indian festivals, St Patrick's Day, Carnival/Fasching, St Nicholas/Nikolaus, Mother's/Father's Day, Black Friday as its own category, Advent calendars as a category. All qty are the server-rendered PLP total ('N Produkte'), each cross-checked against its own page's canonical URL and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to place it correctly in the hierarchy.
